plot L1 = 7450;
L1.SetDefaultColor(Color.RED);
L1.SetLineWeight(1);
L1.HideBubble();
L1.HideTitle();
AddChartBubble(IsNaN(close[-1]) and !IsNaN(close), L1, "Call Ceiling 7450", Color.RED, yes);
